# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 03-seller
# (### NN_Service format). init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored).
# This .example is the committed PLACEHOLDER; real secrets go only in the
# gitignored copy, never here.
#
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   nano env/components-creds.txt          # paste real values
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev
#
# 03-seller reads ONLY these blocks: 01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 04_Redis 05_Kafka
# 07_Elastic_APM (+ the Auth_Identity block). Other blocks are ignored —
# including 03_Elasticsearch (:9201), the search/review business ES used ONLY by
# 05-search + 08-review. Paste your FULL infra dump; init-env.sh reads only what
# it needs.
#
# VERIFY-ONLY: seller never holds the RS256 private key. Paste auth's PUBLIC key
# + the shared INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into the ### Auth_Identity block below
# (from 01-auth's rendered .env.dev: JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 / INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN).

### 01_PostgreSQL
   endpoint       postgresql://<user>:<password>@<host>:5432/postgres
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin
   host:port      <host>:27017
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 04_Redis
   endpoint       redis://default:<password>@<host>:6379/0
   host:port      <host>:6379
   user           default
   password       <password>

### 05_Kafka
   bootstrap      <host>:9092
   ui             http://<host>:8080
   auth           none (PLAINTEXT)

# --- 07's `elasticsearch` line (:9200) IS the application log sink for seller. ---
### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<apm-es-password>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      <apm-bearer-token>
   kibana-ui      http://<host>:5601  (login: elastic)
   elastic-pass   <apm-es-password>

# --- Auth_Identity: paste from 01-auth's rendered .env.dev (NOT generated here). ---
### Auth_Identity
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
